title: 第十三章 无耻学生第一更第十四章 修改功法第二更
content_zh:
原本冷漠如冰的沈碧茹听到对话，也微微一笑。
这种正反绕口的骂人方法，在地球算不上什么，但在这里，却新奇无比。
见女神这副表情，尚斌觉得自己在被嘲笑，脸色一阵红一阵白，不过，当着女神的面，还要保持风度，不敢对张悬直接出手。
“怎么，我说的有错吗？”强忍住怒意，尚斌冷笑：“你什么水平，整个学院恐怕没人不知道！这个胖子，刚才来过我的课堂，肥胖如猪不说，就会个防御，其他什么都不会！拳力只有可怜的15公斤！入门考核，不是倒数第一就是倒数第二，不是垃圾是什么？”
虽然不能出手教训张悬，也要用言语打击一下对方。
“入门考试倒数第一？”张悬只看到了龙犀血脉，并不知道还有这种情况，转头看向胖子。
“谁说是倒数第一？”胖子理直气壮的反驳了一句，然后尴尬的挠头：“我只是……考了第9997名而已！”
“9997名？还而已？”张悬一阵眩晕，差点没吐血。
洪天学院每年招收1万名学员，虽然有这么多名额，但总有几个学生出现这样那样的原因，未来报道，9997名，已经等于最后一名了好不好！
而且……这么低的名次，你有什么可理直气壮的……
张悬也是醉了。
“你不会是招不到学生，只要是学员都收吧？”尚斌再次冷笑，一甩衣袖，满脸的高傲：“我招收学生有一个明确要求，低于500名以下的，绝不会收！倒数第一的老师，倒数第一的学生……还真般配！哈哈！”
“说完了？”
对于他的嘲笑，张悬摇摇头：“说完了，你可以走了！”
刚才他用天道图书馆看了，这个胖子是散修，没有功法之类的修炼，不会武技很正常，只要想办法激活他的龙犀血脉，修为肯定突飞猛进。
“你……”
换做别人，受到这种嘲笑，肯定早就气的浑身颤抖，怒火燃烧了，眼前这家伙却毫不在乎，尚斌一拳打在棉花上，脸色顿时变得更加难看。
“真是朽木不可雕！”一声冷哼，尚斌看向身边的沈碧茹：“碧柔老师，我们走，和这种垃圾家伙待得久了，早晚也会被传染！”
听到尚斌直接这样讽刺，沈碧茹秀眉蹙了一下，并未跟他离开，惹事转头看过来：“张悬老师！”
声音如同黄莺，清脆动人，给人异样的感觉。

“嗯？”没想到这位学院最美丽的老师，会主动和他说话，张悬微微一愣。
“虽然你上次……师资考核成绩不好，但也不要自暴自弃，好好努力，还会不错的！”
沈碧茹点点头。
在她看来，张悬收了最差的一名学生，很显然是对自己不抱希望，自暴自弃了。
面对这位曾经的追求者，她就算无心，也不愿意见他就此沉沦下去。
“多谢提醒！”知道对方是真心为自己好，张悬点头，解释了一句：“这个学员，虽然现在什么都不会，但难保不是璞玉，只要好好教授，未免不能放光！”
“嗯！”
沈碧茹不再说话，抬脚向前走去。
张悬的解释，在她看来只是借口罢了，这么胖，现在这么大年纪了还没系统学过知识，以后成就肯定有限了。
“可恶！”
见自己的女神，居然和学院最差的一位老师说话，还鼓励他，尚斌脸色狰狞的宛如扭曲，心中怒火燃烧，冷冷看了张悬一眼，紧跟了上去。
“碧柔，以后少和这种人接触，会影响你无瑕气质的……”
“尚老师，我今天有些累了，想要回去休息，希望你不要跟着了……”
content_en:
Shen Biru, who was originally as cold as ice, also smiled slightly when she heard the conversation.
This kind of convoluted way of swearing is nothing on Earth, but here, it is extremely novel.
Seeing the goddess's expression, Shang Bin felt that he was being laughed at, and his face turned red and white. However, in front of the goddess, he had to maintain his grace and did not dare to take direct action against Zhang Xuan.
"What, am I wrong?" Suppressing his anger, Shang Bin sneered: "I'm afraid no one in the entire college knows your level! This fat man came to my class just now. He is as fat as a pig and can only defend himself. He can't do anything else! His boxing strength is only a pitiful 15 kilograms! In the entrance examination, you are either the last one or the second last one. What is it if it's not garbage?"
Although you can't teach Zhang Xuan a lesson, you still have to use words to hit him.
"The last one in the entrance exam?" Zhang Xuan only saw the Dragon Rhinoceros bloodline and didn't know there was such a situation. He turned to look at the fat man.
"Who said he was ranked last?" Fatty retorted confidently, and then scratched his head in embarrassment: "I just... ranked 9997th in the exam!"
"9997? Just pay it back?" Zhang Xuan felt dizzy and almost vomited blood.
Hongtian College recruits 10,000 students every year. Although there are so many places, there are always a few students who have one reason or another. According to future reports, 9,997 students are already equal to the last one, okay?
And...with such a low ranking, what can you say to be confident...
Zhang Xuan was also drunk.
"It's not like you can't recruit students, so you'll accept all students, right?" Shang Bin sneered again, flicking his sleeves, with a proud look on his face: "I have a clear requirement for recruiting students. I will never accept students with less than 500 students! The teacher who is the last teacher, the student who is the last... they are really a good match! Haha!"
"Finished?"
In response to his ridicule, Zhang Xuan shook his head: "That's it, you can leave!"
He just used the library of Tiandao to read it. This fat man is a casual cultivator. He has no training in martial arts and so on. It is normal that he does not know martial arts. As long as he finds a way to activate his dragon and rhinoceros bloodline, his cultivation will definitely improve by leaps and bounds.
"You..."
Anyone else would have been trembling with rage and burning with anger after receiving such ridicule, but the guy in front of him didn't care. Shang Bin punched the cotton, and his face suddenly became even more ugly.
"It's really rotten wood that cannot be carved!" With a cold snort, Shang Bin looked at Shen Biru beside him: "Teacher Birou, let's go. If you stay with this kind of garbage guy for a long time, sooner or later you will be infected!"
Hearing Shang Bin's direct sarcasm, Shen Biru frowned, but did not leave with him. She turned around and said, "Teacher Zhang Xuan!"
The voice is like an oriole, crisp and moving, giving people a strange feeling.
"Huh?" Unexpectedly, the most beautiful teacher in the college would take the initiative to talk to him, Zhang Xuan was slightly stunned.
"Although you did not do well in the teacher assessment last time, don't give up on yourself. Work hard and you will do well!"
Shen Biru nodded.
In her opinion, Zhang Xuan accepted the worst student, and it was obvious that he had no hope for himself and gave up on himself.
Facing this former suitor, even if she had no intention of doing so, she was unwilling to see him sink like this.
"Thank you for reminding me!" Knowing that the other party was really doing it for his own good, Zhang Xuan nodded and explained: "Although this student doesn't know anything now, there is no guarantee that he is not a diamond in the rough. As long as he teaches well, he will not be able to shine!"
"Yeah!"
Shen Biru stopped talking and walked forward.
In her opinion, Zhang Xuan's explanation was just an excuse. He is so fat and has not learned knowledge systematically at such an old age. His achievements in the future will definitely be limited.
"Damn it!"
Seeing that his goddess was actually talking to one of the worst teachers in the college and encouraging him, Shang Bin's face was twisted and his heart was filled with anger. He gave Zhang Xuan a cold look and followed closely.go.
"Birou, avoid contact with people like this in the future, it will affect your flawless temperament..."
"Teacher Shang, I'm a little tired today and want to go back to rest. I hope you won't follow me..."
